queries.query: Find datasets related to the phagosomal compartments during phagocytosis of C. albicans where the acquisition type is not 'acquisition' and the publication year is 2021.
Look for studies on the biomechanical structures of the frog tympanic membrane where the publication year is 2026 and the analysis includes at least 10 samples from different species.
Look for studies on Hummers graphite oxide swelling in liquid 1-alcohols where the chain length is greater than C9 and the publication year is 2026.
Look for research proposals related to structural biology and material sciences where the publication year is 2026.
Look for studies on hybrid organic-inorganic phase change materials where the temperature-dependent analysis includes powder XRD and the publication year is 2027.
Look for research on x-ray magnetic circular dichroism in RuO2 thin films where the publication year is 2027 and the experiment is scheduled between April 16 and April 22, 2024.
Look for research projects on protein structure-function relationships in human health and biotechnology that utilize X-ray crystallography and cryo-EM, with a release date set for March 29, 2027.
Find research on protein/DNA complexes and molecular mechanisms from the BAG Barcelona project where the publication year is 2027 and the project runs from September 21, 2024, to September 21, 2027.
Find datasets related to GaAs surfaces acquired using the ID31 instrument, with a file count greater than 26 and a planned release date after May 14, 2024.
Look for research on sodium-ion batteries where the study involves antimony carbon nanocomposites as anodes and was conducted using the ID15A instrument.

Look for research on residual stress measurements in austenitic stainless steel where the experiment energy is greater than 1.5 and the publication year is 2013.

Search for studies on Li3Co2-xNixRuO6 oxides where the publication year is 2012 and the magnetic behavior includes ferromagnetic properties with a transition temperature of 100 K.

Search for studies on the structural determination of PAMAM dendrimer/SDS complexes where the publication year is 2013 and the sample includes poly(amidoamine) dendrimer generation 2.
Look for studies on the co-adsorption of monoclonal antibodies and non-ionic surfactants at the SiO2/water interface where the temperature is 20°C and the publication year is 2019.
